title: Chapter 292: Tamura Is Expelled
content:
Chapter 292: Tamura Is Expelled

During this trip, Wang Shuo also brought Zou Yuanjie and Gong Zheng with him.

Now, Wang Shuo has more and more powerful generals, but Gong Zheng is always the one who makes him feel most secure.

After destroying small groups of undead along the way, it took another two hours, and Tiancun was in sight.

Tiancun is not within the radiation range of Nanshanji, but in the nearby Xiaochi Town.

It is only more than 80 kilometers away from Wana Town.

Wang Shuo slowly approached, and when he could see the figures in the village with his naked eyes, Wang Shuo took out the thousand-mile tube.

After a careful observation, he handed the thousand-mile tube to several commanders who were accompanying him.

The wall of Tiancun is not made of bronze bricks, but it is also strong and about ten meters high.

The boss attacking Tiancun is only silver, and the attacking undead skeletons are not the main force.

So Tiancun can be defended.

After reading it, Li Jianguo immediately said: "Lord, I only need one round of attack, I am confident that I can destroy this city wall."

Wang Shuo also wanted to experience what it felt like to crush withering and rotten.

Last time when Nanshanji was captured, there were too many bribed insiders, and the tenacity of the defending army was not reflected at all.

"Okay, let me see how strong the strongest firepower of our Wana Town is."

This time, Li Jianguo brought 30 catapults.

The productivity of the woodworking workshop can fully meet the consumption of the army in Wana Town.

At this time, the crossbow battalion can be said to have sufficient ammunition.

With thirty shells falling on the city wall, the city wall collapsed.

Wang Shuo showed approval on his face.

Afterwards, he took the lead and charged into the village.

"Baga, the enemy is attacking, quickly defend the city wall."

Wang Shuo's mood became very happy when he heard the pure "Baga", and the weeping blood gun in his hand seemed to be unable to hold back.

Half an hour later, Wang Shuo rescued more than 100 people who were still alive and didn't say "ba ga".

Originally, there were still hundreds of them. Men were forced to work, and many women couldn't bear the humiliation and committed suicide.

These damned people, seeing these compatriots who were tortured to the point of not looking like humans, really wanted to smash all the egg yolks in Tiancun.

When leaving, Wang Shuo set fire to the entire Tiancun.

Mainly because he didn't want these corpses to be transformed into skeleton soldiers by the undead.

Wang Shuo didn't have time to escort these old, weak, sick and disabled people. After giving them some supplies, he let them go to Nanshanji on their own.

He had cleared all the undead along the way.

As long as the luck is not too bad, they should be able to arrive alive.

Continue on the road.

Changping County is in the east of Nanshanji, and it is exactly in a straight line with Wana Town, 200 kilometers away.

Wang Shuo killed the undead along the way. As long as he didn't encounter the undead army besieging the town, he basically swept all the way.

During this period, Wang Shuo destroyed a total of 15 altars of the dead.

He temporarily ranked second.

The first place is still the mysterious Dongshi Town.

The third place is Su Xiu. Wang Shuo's undercover Wang Bao finally successfully joined Su Xiu's Jiuyuan Town.

As for the first place Dongshi Town, Wang Shuo sent Si Xinyi, who was living outside, to inquire about the news.

When Si Xinyi received the news from Wang Shuo, she was working as a courtesan in Yichunyuan, Luohe County.

Relying on her beauty, she collected a lot of useful information.

As night fell, Wang Shuo collected all the dead spirit beads of the Chiyan Army again and purified them uniformly.

"Lord, there are another 50 miles ahead to Changping County. Are we going to rush over like this?"

"Yuan Jie, what do you suggest?"

"Lord, I think we should first find out how strong the nearby undead are. If we attack rashly, we may be at a disadvantage."

Wang Shuo nodded secretly. It is indeed necessary to investigate it carefully.
